Original blocks may crack or have stripped threads after impact and fail to hold the handlebar. Installing this block restores clamping force.Stem (Forehead) + Clamp Block Set:1. The handlebar tube goes through the semicircular recess of the stem body and the clamp block. Tighten the screw to hold the tube firmly and prevent rotation while riding.3. Steering load support. Hand steering force transfers through the stem to the folding stem and front fork. Aluminum alloy provides stable structural strength.4. All-in-one replacement.
